# Test archives

- `testmod.7z` is a synthetic archive created for this project. It contains a
  minimal `Mods/aircraft/Test7z` tree and is used by the 7z import test.
- `testfile.rar3.rar`, `testfile.rar5.rar` and `testfile.rar5.solid.rar` are the
  minimal RAR test files from
  [ssokolow/rar-test-files](https://github.com/ssokolow/rar-test-files),
  released under CC0. They are used to exercise RAR3, RAR5 and solid RAR
  extraction.
